method: Balanced four-label trials; oldA/oldB identical raw CPU bytes, newA/newB identical optimized bytes; one unchanged native Module. Fresh CPU Modules/instances and equal warmups; construction, optimization and snapshots excluded from execution timing. Exact PCM, full architectural/diagnostic state and pins checked after every audio block or direct run. Ratios above1 favor optimized CPU. Cold generation/optimization/compile are separate one-shot observations, not startup medians or browser guarantees.
